related.title: Wi-Fi 7 MLO：平行鏈路與封包重新排序
related.titleEn: Wi-Fi7 MLO: parallel links and packet reordering
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付物能重現 1.58362492095 dB additional loss 與 7.95880017344 dB additional loss，保留失敗情境且每個通過判定有明確門檻；需分開列出模型未涵蓋的實際系統驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The artifacts must reproduce 1.58362492095 dB additional loss and 7.95880017344 dB additional loss, preserve failing scenarios and attach a threshold to each pass decision; list actual-system validation outside this model separately.
related.difference: 能推導並解釋28 ms completion與40 ms completion，建立mlo_arrivals.csv、重排緩衝圖、鏈路配置，並完成以下驗收：35 ms整批期限僅第一組通過；必要時改流量分配而非對所有流強制雙鏈路。
related.differenceEn: Derive and explain 28 ms completion and 40 ms completion; create mlo_arrivals.csv, reorder-buffer diagram and link assignment; apply this acceptance decision: Only the first meets a35 ms batch deadline; adjust assignment rather than forcing every flow across both links.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 從原理 固定距離與天線增益的自由空間損耗差為20log10(f2/f1)；不把頻率差誤當法定發射功率差。 展開基準式 20*log10(6/5)；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：用波長平方比例反算，並在圖上明確標同距離；實際法規與設備模式另查當地規定。 將兩條推導一起存入 wifi6e_pathloss.csv、波長對照、環境/法規待查項。
從原理 多鏈路可分配資料到不同服務率與延遲的路徑；聚合率受最慢交付與重排緩衝限制。 展開基準式 max(1/100*1000+2,1/50*1000+8)；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：逐鏈路畫首/末位元抵達時間，重排窗口由最早到最晚差決定，不能只比較速率總和。 將兩條推導一起存入 mlo_arrivals.csv、重排緩衝圖、鏈路配置。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Starting from At equal distance and antenna gains, free-space loss difference is20log10(f2/f1); this is not a difference in legally permitted transmit power., expand baseline expression 20*log10(6/5); record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Cross-check with wavelength-squared ratios and mark equal distance; actual regulations and device modes require local verification. Save both derivations with wifi6e_pathloss.csv, wavelength checks and environment/regulation questions.

Starting from Multiple links can divide traffic across different rates and delays; effective aggregation is constrained by completion and reordering., expand baseline expression max(1/100*1000+2,1/50*1000+8); record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Plot first/last-bit arrivals per link; reorder span depends on earliest/latest arrival rather than rate sum alone. Save both derivations with mlo_arrivals.csv, reorder-buffer diagram and link assignment.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Thread 無線路徑：ETX 與鏈路成功率
related.titleEn: Thread radio paths: ETX and link success probabilities
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付物能重現 1.58362492095 dB additional loss 與 7.95880017344 dB additional loss，保留失敗情境且每個通過判定有明確門檻；需分開列出模型未涵蓋的實際系統驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The artifacts must reproduce 1.58362492095 dB additional loss and 7.95880017344 dB additional loss, preserve failing scenarios and attach a threshold to each pass decision; list actual-system validation outside this model separately.
related.difference: 能推導並解釋2.22222222222 expected transmissions與2.43867243867 expected transmissions，建立thread_links.csv、方向別成功率、路徑ETX表，並完成以下驗收：在相同每次時間與能量假設下選A；若單跳速率不同則改用時間/能量加權，不能只比ETX。
related.differenceEn: Derive and explain 2.22222222222 expected transmissions and 2.43867243867 expected transmissions; create thread_links.csv, directional success rates and route ETX table; apply this acceptance decision: ChooseA only under equal time/energy per attempt; otherwise weight by airtime or energy rather than ETX alone.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 從原理 固定距離與天線增益的自由空間損耗差為20log10(f2/f1)；不把頻率差誤當法定發射功率差。 展開基準式 20*log10(6/5)；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：用波長平方比例反算，並在圖上明確標同距離；實際法規與設備模式另查當地規定。 將兩條推導一起存入 wifi6e_pathloss.csv、波長對照、環境/法規待查項。
從原理 簡化獨立成功率p鏈路需平均1/p次嘗試，多跳路徑ETX相加；未納入競爭、確認損失或非對稱。 展開基準式 1/0.9+1/0.9；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：逐跳計幾何期望再加總；較強第一跳不代表整條路較好，保留第二跳反例。 將兩條推導一起存入 thread_links.csv、方向別成功率、路徑ETX表。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。

Use this independent representation: Cross-check with wavelength-squared ratios and mark equal distance; actual regulations and device modes require local verification. Save both derivations with wifi6e_pathloss.csv, wavelength checks and environment/regulation questions.

Starting from A link with independent success probabilityp needs1/p mean attempts; path ETX sums links, excluding contention, ACK loss and asymmetry., expand baseline expression 1/0.9+1/0.9; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Calculate geometric expectations per link then sum; a stronger first hop does not guarantee the better route. Save both derivations with thread_links.csv, directional success rates and route ETX table.
